_comment: Cards that exist only for the gain-becomes-loss test (tests/unit/players/test_life_gain_becomes_loss.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_rot_fly` is Plague Drone's Rot Fly line on its own, on an artifact so nothing else about it can matter. `t_self_rot_fly` points the same replacement at its controller, the only way to test `affects_player` from player 0's seat. The doublers are `t_opponent_archive` and `t_opponent_vitality`, the loss doubler `t_always_bloodletter`, the lifelinker `t_lifelink_bear`, Erebos `t_erebos` and the gain spell `t_gain_spell`.
